title: SpecOps External Findings Input Contract
description: Versioned, stack-neutral contract consumed by `specops handoff finding import-json` (Feature 015). Every imported finding becomes an advisory Feature 011 finding carrying producer and reviewed-diff-digest provenance. No producer may set blocking severity at import (FR-005); severity here is informational only.

contract_version.description: Contract schema version. Current supported: 1. An unknown value fails closed (exit 2).

producer.description: Default producer for every finding in this document (a finding MAY override). Recorded as-declared; never authenticated (FR-003/FR-019).

reviewed_commit.description: Optional commit the reviewer ran against, applied to every finding lacking its own. Absent ⇒ SpecOps captures the current HEAD at import (FR-004).

findings.description: Zero or more findings. An empty array is a supported no-op success (exit 0).

name.description: Tool or human identifier (e.g. "codeql", "acme-llm-reviewer", "jdoe"). Required; missing ⇒ import defect.

file.description: Repository-relative path the finding points at. Normalized on import; basis for the per-location reviewed digest and staleness.

action.description: Concise reviewer statement / recommended action. Becomes the finding's action text.

severity.description: Producer-declared severity. INFORMATIONAL ONLY — every imported finding is recorded `advisory` regardless (FR-005). Retained for the audit trail.

producer.description: Optional per-finding producer override of the document-level producer.

reviewed_commit.description: Optional per-finding commit override of the document-level reviewed_commit.
